profile.headline: Senior Full Stack Developer and Architect at Ouroboros Development, LLC
profile.summary:
Experienced Senior Software Architect, Developer and Administrator with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in Full Stack (Microsoft, LAMP, AWS, Azure, SharePoint, Databases, Data Warehousing, Windows Communication Foundation (WCF), ((Full Stack(C#/VB).Net)MVC), Angular, React, Node, Typescript(UI/UX)), LAMP Full Stack, CI/CD, DI/IoC, Docker, Jenkins, Business Performance Management, Business Intelligence, Powershell. Dynamics 365 Development and Administration.C, Objective C, C++, TCP/IP, UDP, Perl, Python, B-K Shells, Bash, fstab, machine and assembly, device drivers.
Oracle, MySQL, MS SQL,MongoDB, etc.
Strong engineering professional with an Associate of Applied Science (A.A.S.) focused in Electrical and Electronics Engineering from ITT Technical Institute-San Diego.
